briefing.text: Information Technology tops sector attention on all three platforms: News buzz 88.4 (+7.1 vs the day before, +1.4 on the week, mentions +384%, sentiment 0.26; NVDA, MSFT, AMD), X buzz 93.4 (+1.1, mentions +46%, sentiment 0.12; NVDA, MU, IREN) and Reddit buzz 95.2 (+1.7, mentions +235%, sentiment -0.03; NVDA, ANT, AAPL). On News the biggest buzz gains were Utilities +20.0 (mentions +429%, sentiment 0.27; DUK, NEE, FLNC), Financials +16.7 (sentiment 0.03; BAC, MS, UBS) and Energy +13.9 (mentions +433%; TPL, XOM, COP). On Reddit, Healthcare rose +18.2 (+16.4 on the week, MEDS only) and Utilities +9.6 (ENA, WAVE, VST), while Consumer Staples slipped -1.8 (WMT, PEP, KO). On X, Communication Services moved up to rank 3 (buzz 90.6, +1.1; NBIS, GOOGL, META) and Healthcare is +28.7 on the week but small (MEDS, VBIO, BRVE).

ADI #1: previews ahead of its Nov 24 results ("Why Analog Devices Stock Is In Focus Ahead Of Results"); 26 articles in 2 days, mostly neutral to positive. Explains the rank.
DELL #2: named in market-open roundups with HPE and SMTC amid Iran sanctions and Hormuz headlines; 75 articles, 37 positive, and earnings are due 11-24. Partly explains the rank.
ZM #3: listed in the Nvidia-led chip rally futures roundup; 28 articles, neutral. Does not explain the rank by itself.
KR #4: Thanksgiving travel and Walmart vs Target retail pieces; earnings are not until 12-03. Weak explanation.
DLTR #5: Dollar Tree beat earnings and raised its annual profit forecast (11-24), sentiment 1.0. Explains the rank.
SBUX #6: generic restaurant-stocks-to-watch and big-tech founders pieces; no specific catalyst. Does not explain the rank.
NVDA #7: 1,928 articles in 2 days (725 positive, 220 negative), with the chip rally continuing; consistent with the +31% 24h move.
KOSPI #8: Korea ETF rebound and Asian markets falling after the Wall Street selloff; only 2 articles. Fits the FOMC Dec 9 catalyst loosely.

ADI ranks first (score 0.946, T1): attention is 1.16x normal, attention on X 1.21x, and the 24h price move is 2.2 sigmas, with earnings due 11-24; volume is below normal (0.38x). DELL is second (0.935): its price moved +20.4% in 24h (3.0 sigmas) and volume is 0.74x normal, while attention is below normal (0.79x); earnings 11-24 are the catalyst. ZM is third (0.917): attention is 1.83x normal and attention on X 1.95x, the highest of the top three, volume is 0.78x, and the move is 1.6 sigmas, with a KPI market resolving as the catalyst.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
